captions.detailed: A premium countertop bread maker featuring a low, wide matte black base, a matching rectangular lid with an integrated glass viewing window, and an adjacent control panel. The control panel is built around a central black ring dial surrounded by five square light-grey tactile buttons. Articulation features include a rear-hinged main lid that rotates upward, a small rotating vent cap on the lid, a continuously rotating kneading spindle inside the baking chamber, a continuously rotating ring dial, and five individual prismatic push buttons.
captions.instruction: Generate a premium countertop bread maker with a wide black base, a hinged top lid containing a glass window, and a control panel with a central ring dial and five surrounding square buttons. Incorporate revolute joints for the main lid and a small vent cap, continuous joints for the internal kneading spindle and the ring dial, and prismatic joints for each of the five control buttons.
captions.factory: Construct the main base using a filleted box, then hollow out the baking chamber and add a rotating cylindrical kneading spindle in the center. Model the lid by combining a rectangular frame with a transparent glass insert, and attach it to the rear of the base with a revolute joint. Create the control panel on the base using a cylindrical ring dial (continuous joint) and five small rectangular extrusions (prismatic joints) arranged symmetrically around it. Finally, add a small rectangular vent cap on the lid with its own revolute joint.
